department: School of Computer Science and Statistics (PhD, Computer Science)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year; start in March or September. To be considered for funding, apply between January and April for a September start.
deadline.quote: Applications can be made at any time of the year, and the programme starts in March and September. If you are looking for funding to do a PhD (see Finance and fees) then it is best to apply between January and April

supervisor.value: The first step is to contact a School supervisor; you apply to the programme only if a staff member agrees to support you.
supervisor.quote: The first step in the application process is to contact a supervisor in the School. | If a member of staff agrees to support your application to the PhD programme, then the next step is to apply

funding.value: An offer of supervision does not mean the place is funded; students rely on Trinity awards, IRC studentships or supervisors' grants.
funding.quote: an offer from a member of staff to supervise your project, and successful application to the programme, does not imply that the position is funded.
